floor_history.headline: Recon: engine floor 17 is CHEAT-INFLATED — the HEAD form's volatile-coerced cosA read is not stripped by the sandbox; the honest cheat-free floor is 26, and it decomposes into exactly two independent

Floor 26 -> 13 cheat-free: mechanism A (the cosA lhu+sll16/sra16 shape) CLOSED in pure C by putting an a1[] store between the u16 staging load and its (s16) cast, which blocks combine's fold; build_in
Floor 13 -> 12 cheat-free: delaying the LAST use of the parameter pointer (angC = a0[2] moved after the sinA*sinB statement) flips angC to target's $v1 and its cos-index temp to $v0, closing the angC

frontier.hypothesis: Target's mflo/sra placement and the delayed-a0[2] register win are separately reachable and can be held TOGETHER; the candidate (12) has the registers, the split-multiply form (13) has the schedule.
frontier.mechanism: Both effects are decided in the same 10-insn window (insns 17-26): whether the angC load precedes or follows the mult in the pre-allocation stream fixes angC/$v1, and whether the shift precedes or follows the death of the cos-index temp fixes sinAxsinB_12/$v0. Nothing couples them in principle -- every spelling tried so far just happened to move both.
frontier.next_probe: Enumerate that window systematically, varying independently (i) the spelling of sinA*sinB (one statement / two / inline at each use / through a third variable), (ii) the position of the a0[2] read relative to each of those, and (iii) presence of idxB/idxC locals -- and read insns 15-32 with tmp/grind/.../s3/sbs.py for EVERY form, not just its score. Scores alone hid the separability this session.

frontier.hypothesis: The only residual quantity (sinAxsinB_12, 'used 3 times across 17 insns', priority 0.176) is refused $v0 for a specific, identifiable reason at find_free_reg time -- conflict with the cos-index temp's range, or never being reached in REG_ALLOC_ORDER.
frontier.mechanism: local-alloc assigns in qty priority order and this quantity is nearly last, so it inherits whatever is free; the candidate (12) and the split form (13) differ in exactly this decision, which makes them a controlled A/B pair.
frontier.next_probe: FORENSICS: rebuild cc1 with the BB2_ALLOC_DEBUG / BB2_PRIO_DEBUG instrumentation named in the s1 ledger (or a printf in block_alloc) and dump the sorted qty_order plus every find_free_reg decision for BOTH forms. Diff the two dumps -- the first divergent decision is the answer. Do not dump only one form.

frontier.hypothesis: The delayed-last-parameter-use spelling is a property of the original 3x3 rotation-matrix source idiom, so it also moves the two rule-carrying siblings, one of which may have a smaller residual than sinAxsinB_12.
frontier.mechanism: _SelectSection (10 rules) and hirahira_w_ctrl_2 (63 rules, the signature twice) are the same idiom in the same file and their regfix comments name the SAME two mechanisms (the la/volatile cosA addressing block and sinAxsinB_12 in $a0-vs-$v0). A mechanism present in all three is a property of the shared source idiom.
frontier.next_probe: Apply the candidate.c spelling (u16 staging read + interleaved blocking store + a0[2] read delayed past the sinA*sinB statement) to each sibling and score with sandbox --disable all. If either lands with no sinAxsinB_12 residual, prototype that half there and port back. This is a measurement on a sibling, not a change of target function.
